candidateUniverse.knownBias: no failed or acquired company has a price panel in the sealed history; prospective data does not have this bias
candidateUniverse.membership: S&P 500, latest snapshot strictly earlier than the signal date
candidateUniverse.sectors: Financials and Real Estate excluded (earnings-yield and operating-cash-flow definitions differ); owner decision D4
candidateUniverse.survivorship: departed members stay while members; a held name without an exit price is unresolved, never zero

features.cashConfirmation: (OCF - capex) / OCF from the PR #220 engine, OCF > 0
features.composite: equal-weight mean of within-date percentile ranks of the pre-declared features; no fitted weight, no sector neutralisation, no tuning
excludedUntilVerified: any 13F or macro input (separate registered hypothesis required)
features.valueBasis: RECONSTRUCTED as-traded price (pipeline/us_multifactor_inputs.py); a split between filing and observation withholds the yield; numerator share counts are weighted-average and unverified

forbiddenInThisProposal: choosing weights or thresholds from past returns
outcomeBlindEligibility: positive close at most 10 calendar days old with at least 272 prior sessions
latest visible report period ended at most 180 days earlier
every composite feature present (no imputation, no fill, missing is never zero)
minimum scored names per week fixed from the power table before registration (recommended >= 150)

pastDataClassification.allowedUse: outcome-blind readiness work (coverage, redundancy, definitions) only. Never confirmatory, never used to choose a weight, threshold or feature.
consumedBy: regional-alpha-model-v1: US annual models trained 2016 to 2026 on the 31-feature matrix; one-shot discovery budget spent (AGENTS.md v2.24)
pastDataClassification.notClaimedExhaustive: any other study that evaluated US forward returns is assumed to have exposed the same window
pastDataClassification.signalDates: 2013-01-04 to about 2026-03 (126-session labels matured inside the sealed data, which ends 2026-09-14)

pastDataClassification.allowedUse: same as above; not a holdout
pastDataClassification.reason: stock-level 126-session outcomes do not exist, but sealed prices through 2026-09-14 are visible to the program and the SPY/QQQ path was published descriptively (PR #221)
no point-in-time S&P 500 membership before the 2012-12-27 snapshot; 2011-2012 prices are feature warm-up only

pastDataClassification.definition: signals dated after the authorizing merge of a registration; their outcomes do not exist when the rule is frozen
pastDataClassification.role: the only confirmatory evidence the program can produce

prerequisitesBeforeRegistration.kind: data acquisition and a step in an existing workflow

primaryHypothesis.benchmarkInvariance: the IC is the same against SPY and QQQ because the benchmark return is constant within a date; SPY is primary, QQQ alternative, and the SPY-vs-QQQ difference is reported as the passive growth spread, never as selection
primaryHypothesis.economic: Within the S&P 500, companies that are simultaneously inexpensive on earnings and free-cash-flow yield and profitable with earnings confirmed by operating cash flow earn higher subsequent 126-session returns than their cross-sectional peers, beyond what price momentum and risk already order.
primaryHypothesis.mechanism: compensation for risk and slow investor adjustment to cash-confirmed profitability; it is a hypothesis, not a result
primaryHypothesis.statistic: mean cross-sectional Spearman rank correlation (IC) between the composite score and the H126 benchmark-relative return

relationToV1: independent; v1 (US_CAPITAL_ALLOCATION_SELECTION_V1, digest 73c347a34bc53f038c9e33ebbc2cb322960f33fc4170919b85d2561a4f073342) is neither modified nor replaced and keeps its own owner decision

stopAndFailureCriteria.failure: at the gate: the one-sided 95% upper bound of the mean IC is not above zero
stopAndFailureCriteria.inconclusive: neither, or any unresolved terminal outcome in a scored basket
stopAndFailureCriteria.noRetroactiveChange: benchmarks, horizons and gates cannot be edited after observation
operationalStop: fewer scored names than the floor on 8 consecutive weeks
price or membership input older than its limit on any signal date (BLOCKED receipt)
a feature definition or source changes (new study id)
stopAndFailureCriteria.success: at the gate: the one-sided 95% lower bound of the mean IC is above zero AND the IC clears a pre-declared minimum useful size

transactionCosts.convention: weekly-passive-first-v1 switchCost: round trip of the stock plus round trip of the ETF leg it displaces

twoStageDesign.stage1_signalValidity: score EVERY eligible name every week and record the rank information; paper only; the evidence accumulates with breadth, not with five holdings
twoStageDesign.stage2_investability: 0-5 names only if a hurdle calibrated on PROSPECTIVE stage 1 evidence exceeds cost plus a declared margin; until calibrated the output is UNCALIBRATED_HURDLE and 100% benchmark. Zero stocks is the normal and initial outcome
twoStageDesign.whyTwoStages: a five-name book cannot resolve a realistic excess for years (see power); a signal can be tested on hundreds of names a week

validation.confirmatoryEvidence: prospective only; the rule, features and parameters are frozen by hash before the first scored week
validation.inference: circular moving-block bootstrap of the weekly IC series, block 26 weeks (one horizon), one-sided 95%, single look at the maturity gate
validation.interimLooks: none for efficacy; one pre-declared futility look at 6 independent windows (statistician sign-off required before registration)
validation.multiplicity: ONE primary claim (the IC); the stage 2 book and QQQ comparisons are secondary and carry no verdict power until the hurdle is calibrated

assumptions: names within a signal window treated as independent, which flatters the IC table
tracking errors are ASSUMED round numbers, not estimated from any return
windows = 126-session horizons, one independent draw each
power.reading: a 0-5 name book needs years to resolve an excess of several percent a year, so it cannot be the FIRST evidence about a signal; a broad cross-section can, because its information grows with the number of names scored

secondary: top-quintile minus universe spread vs SPY and QQQ

blockers: fresh prices for a prospective run
share-count basis of per-share numerators unverified
candidates.breadth: existing-model inputs 66.2% and plus value 32.3% of eligible member-dates; distribution alone 21.5%
candidates.dataReadiness: PIT numerators exist; as-traded price basis is reconstructable from sealed events (round-trip exact)
candidates.novelty: value was excluded from the closed regional model (price basis unresolved); cash confirmation of earnings was not in its matrix

candidates.note: already registered as v1; breadth 17.9% (<= 30.6% under an unverified candidate view); buyback-led; dilution BLOCKED
economically attractive; BLOCKED until period-end share facts with class and split context are readable (SEC XBRL)
no point-in-time event or earnings-calendar feed exists
inside the closed regional-alpha-model-v1 feature set; a retry would re-tune a closed result

zeroToFiveNamePolicy.hurdle: UNCALIBRATED_HURDLE until stage 1 has at least 12 independent windows; then expected relative return net of 32.6 bp round-trip switch and a declared margin
zeroToFiveNamePolicy.mechanicalTopFive: forbidden: a rank alone never fills a slot
